reviews.text: Thank you, Amritava! We're delighted you chose our trusted dog day care.

We had such a great experience here at Dogtopia! They have their own app with webcam available throughout the stay. We were apprehensive about leaving Jibo at daycare as she had never been left with anyone one else before, only us and the breeder. With the webcam we could observe how she was doing anytime, and were so happy to see that she was well settled and content. Every time we looked there was always an attendant with the pups and the pups were free to roam around or go to the kennels to sleep as they want. Thank you so much for looking after Jibo so well! The way staff interacted with the pups truly showed their passion for the pack of pups staying there. 💕

We’ve had a great experience with Dogtopia of Miramar! The staff are always friendly and welcoming, and I really appreciate being able to check in on our dog through the webcams during the day. He always seems excited to be there and comes home happy and tired after a day of playing. It gives me peace of mind knowing he has a fun place to socialize and burn off some energy. Thank you for taking such good care of him!

Thank you so much for your feedback and lovely review, Justin! Your pups brighten up our day and are a wounderful addition to our Dogtopia family! We have loved watching them grow and create new furry friendships. They truly mean the world to us and we are excited to continue to watch them blossom! If there is anything you need from us, please do not hesitate to reach out! 

Kind regards, 
Malaya and the Dogtopia of Miramar Team
Great staff that are friendly and stay committed to our dogs care. Scrappy and Nala love to play with them and enjoy their visits every time.

We LOVE Dogtopia Miramar!  Nathan and his staff are always so kind, compassionate, and thoughtful while caring for my fur children. My current dog has been going since to daycare for 6 years, and my previous dog went for many years before he passed at 15yo. They each LOVE going to daycare and are tired and happy afterwards. As a nurse it is one of the few doggy daycares that have hours long enough for my 12 hour shifts.  I love their spa options so I can pick her up fresh and clean!
My only request would be that it would be really nice to get cute photos/videos/updates throughout the day. I know they are very busy, but it would definitely be the highlight of my work day! I can never find her on the webcams. Regardless, we are so blessed to have such a great local Dogtopia. Thank you Nathan and staff! We love you!

Everyone was so welcoming and my dog Mabel always has the best time!! She absolutely loves it and gets so excited every time we walk up to the door. The staff is outstanding, so friendly and so amazing with the pups. My first choice for doggy daycare when I’m in San Diego.
Nice place
Thank you, Laura! We appreciate your 5-star rating of Dogtopia of Miramar!

We love Dogtopia! And so does our pup! He can't wait to go each day. He loves playing with his fur friends and is sad if he misses a day. We love all the workers! They are so nice, caring, attentive to details, and love our pup! We couldn't ask for a better place to care for our pup. Thank you!

I just want to say that Dogtopia is our favorite place to take our dogs! We have tried many others but I can say the difference is exceptional! The entire team Cares about your animals! They give real care and love for each and every pet. It’s not just a job. They have many fun activities which also keeps our very busy Aussie extremely happy! When I pick her up she is dog gone tired ! When I finally get her home if I even utter the word Dogtopia!!!!! She is right back on her feet ready to go again! No lie! We also have a small chihuahua whom loves to come and hang out! He is not anxious like other places we’ve tried. He makes friends and. Comes home happy! Great team! great prices! They have a lot to offer and I truly feel that my babies are getting the best care! I’ve done it all over there boarding, daycare, grooming and special events! They also support a lot of good causes and are also up on cleanliness too! Very clean!

Seriously, this facility rocks. They take care of my sweet Milo so well! She is always so excited to come and she comes home so happy, eats dinner, and then is so tuckered out from playing all day! I can tell the workers give her so much love, they update me on her whenever I ask when I pick her up, and she's definitely making other doggy friends and becoming better around other dogs. So happy she is here!
My dog absolutely loves daycare and boarding at this location. They are very communicative and friendly and I know I can trust that he is in the best hands when he is there.!

Both of our dogs, Milo and Ollie love going to Dogtopia. The staff is kind, attentive, and truly cares about the dogs. We always feel confident leaving our pups there knowing they’re safe, happy, and well cared for. Milo and Ollie come home tired and happy every time, which says it all. Highly recommend Dogtopia Miramar

I scheduled a meet and greet, something I've never been required to do before boarding my dog, only to get there and find out I wasn't on the schedule and that the person I spoke to Saturday never called my vet for shot records or scheduled my meet and greet. The girl at the front desk told me to wait and she would "work something out", only to tell me 30 minutes later that because they didn't have my dog's shot records, they couldn't do the meet and greet. She knew the second I arrived they didn't have my shot records. And the reason they didn't have the records was because the person I spoke to Saturday never bothered to got them. So she wasted my time along with the girl I spoke with on Saturday. And, while my time was wasted waitung for a meet & greet that nevrr happened, a couple picked up a German Shepherd who lunged and snapped at my shih tzu. So their meet & greets are just performative as they allow dogs with reactivity & aggression issues.  This place charges twice what my current boarding facility charges. The only reason I was considering them was because my usual place is booked for Christmas. Why would I trust them with my dog, and pay twice the amount to board my dog, when they can't even manage something as simple as scheduling a meet and greet & allow aggressive dogs?

I was recommended this place by coworkers and I couldn’t be happier with the care and attention my dog receives. From the moment we walk through the door, the staff greets my pup with genuine warmth and excitement. You can tell right away that they absolutely love dogs — not just as part of their job. They also offer  grooming options which is incredibly convenient and anytime I've checked the doggy web cam my pup is having a great time playing with other dogs and being watched for with care.

If you’re looking for a place where your dog will be treated like family, cared for with real compassion, and surrounded by people who truly love what they do, this is the place!

Dogtopia has truly become Sammy and Mylo’s happy place. The staff don’t just do their jobs—they genuinely love what they do, and it shows in the way they care for my boys. Sammy runs in like he’s greeting old friends, and Mylo, who’s had a harder time adjusting, is met with so much patience, kindness, and understanding. Seeing how gently they work with him means the world to me.

Somehow they even manage to get both of them through baths and nail trims—something that would be complete chaos at home! I also love the thoughtful activities they plan each day and how dedicated they are to giving back through the Dogtopia Foundation. It gives me so much peace knowing Sammy and Mylo are surrounded by people who truly care and genuinely enjoy making their days brighter.

My dog loves it here and so do I. Having to drive 1.5 hours to work and back everyday and being able to have her here while I'm working makes my life so much easier. They take such great care of of her and the option to always get a bath or grooming done while's she's there is a life saver! Definitely recommend

I’ve been taking my dog here for 5 years and she still gets excited to go! The employees all take wonderful care of her and I feel so much better knowing she has a place away from home where she feels safe.

River has been loving daycare at Dogtopia of Miramar. I really enjoy seeing how many calories and miles he gets in while at work. The staff is friendly and communicative. I would recommend dog daycare here if you what to finance dog daycare expenses as well. Dogtopia of Miramar has weekly and monthly plans to meet the needs of every dog owner. They also do really cute photoshoots!
staff are all super kind and professional, they really know what they're doing! my dog can be difficult sometimes, but I truly trust them to take care of him.

Thank you for the great service Dogtopia has provided for our little Winnie Pooh! I brought her in to help with socializing and mental stimulation and it’s been wonderful. Staff is super friendly , clean faculty, I see the staff cleans up quickly and have protocol sanitation procedures, and price is reasonable. , I love the webcams to check on our fur babies.  They also have special activities/events for the dogs on certain days. I highly recommend if you are looking for a safe and fun environment for your fur babies.  :)
Staff are super friendly and helpful, nice facility and love the webcams to keep tabs on your dog!

Dear Heather, 

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We truly enjoy having your pup as part of our Dogtopia family and are so grateful for your trust in us. My team and I are always here if you’d like to share feedback or suggestions, so please feel free to reach out anytime. We can’t wait to share many more fun and exciting days with your dog and are honored to be a part of their journey!

Warm regards,
Nathan and the Dogtopia of Miramar Team

Dogtopia has been such a great place for Kalani. The staff are professional, kind, and genuinely fun to be around. She looks forward to seeing her friends every day, and somehow even puts up with baths and nail trims (things that are a definite no at home!). I also love the little activities they plan during the day and the way they give back through the Dogtopia Foundation. It feels good knowing she’s cared for by people who love what they do.

Do NOT bring your dog here!!! This place is an absolute nightmare for both pets and owners. (Proof attached!)

First, their grooming is unsafe — my dog actually came back from a bath with a nose injury, something that has never happened anywhere else. After just a 3-day boarding, he also caught kennel cough, which shows how poorly they manage health and safety.

But the billing practices are even worse. I was incorrectly charged three times. The first two times, they refused to refund me and forced me to take credits I didn’t want. Two months ago, when I told them I was moving away, they finally agreed to process a refund. But guess what? Two months later, no refund ever showed up. And today, I was unbelievably charged $232 AGAIN, despite not using their services at all. Their excuse? “We charged the wrong person.” What a joke.

This is beyond unprofessional — it’s dishonest and irresponsible. If you care about your dog’s well-being and your own peace of mind, stay far, far away!!
My dogs love it. I do too. Convenience, friendly staff, great prices, clean facility.
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We appreciate it!

Dear Madeline, 


Thank you so much for the 5-star review! We absolutely love having your pup in our pack, and we're grateful to have you as part of our Dogtopia family. My team and I are always here to listen, so if you ever have feedback or suggestions, please don't hesitate to chat with me at the daycare. We're looking forward to many more fun adventures with your dog and are honored to be part of their day!


Warm regards,
Nathan V.
General Manager

Dear Adam,

Thank you for the 5 stars! It’s a joy to have your pup in our pack, and we’re delighted to have you as part of our Dogtopia family.  Please know that my team and I are always open to feedback.  If there is ever anything that we can do better, please speak with me at the daycare.  We look forward to many more fun-filled days with your furry family member and are excited to continue serving you!

Best regards,

Nathan V.
Store Leader
Ann, we appreciate your 5-star rating of Dogtopia!

The staff are so friendly to my pup Elsy and I! They always ensure me that she’ll be well taken care of. Elsy always comes back clean and happy to see me. I really like how there’s cameras so I can check on my pup while she’s playing. Out of all of the daycares I’ve been at this one is by far the most clean and well organized. I highly recommend taking your pup here! They’ll be loved by the staff and be in a clean and fun environment!
I only use Dogtopia for my dogs boarding Ang daycare. They are great! I even get pictures of how he’s doing when I’m out of town, I highly recommend them!!

Dogtopia Mirmar is amazing. Our dog is not only safe, well cared for, but also completely loves daycare, boarding and grooming at Dogtopia. Nathan, Rhiannon and everyone who works there is so completely amazing with the dogs ... and not just our dog. I have seen them in action with nervous dogs and dogs new to daycare and they really are the best of the best. I honestly don't know what we would have done without the trust and confidence we have in Dogtopia to take care of our dog when we have had work and travel obligations. If I could give a hundred million stars I would!

I’ve been taking my incredibly anxious pup here for daycare and boarding and cannot recommend them enough! They are incredibly attentive, send photos during boarding to let me know how much fun he’s having, and incredibly responsive. They will even do a check-in call sometimes to see how he’s doing after boarding. Highly recommend!
